cause.en: Scientists are still trying to find the main cause of the disease.
cause.zh: 科学家仍在努力寻找这种疾病的主要原因。

cause.en: Heavy rain can cause serious damage to crops in low-lying areas.
cause.zh: 暴雨可能给低洼地区的庄稼造成严重损害。

consequence.en: The loss of forests has had serious consequences for local wildlife.
consequence.zh: 森林消失给当地野生动物带来了严重后果。

outcome.en: The outcome of the experiment surprised even the researchers themselves.
outcome.zh: 实验结果甚至让研究者本人都感到意外。

impact.en: Researchers are still measuring the impact of noise on young children's learning.
impact.zh: 研究者仍在衡量噪音对幼儿学习的影响。

impact.en: Rising sea temperatures have impacted coral reefs across the region.
impact.zh: 不断上升的海水温度已经影响到整个地区的珊瑚礁。

effect.en: The new law had little effect on the number of road accidents.
effect.zh: 新法律对交通事故数量几乎没有影响。

affect.en: Lack of sleep can affect both memory and the ability to make decisions.
affect.zh: 睡眠不足会影响记忆力和决策能力。

influence.en: Parents have a strong influence on the eating habits of their children.
influence.zh: 父母对孩子的饮食习惯有很大影响。

influence.en: Advertising can influence what people choose to buy without their realising it.
influence.zh: 广告可以在不知不觉中影响人们的购买选择。

result-in.en: A small rise in temperature could result in the loss of many species.
result-in.zh: 气温小幅上升可能导致许多物种消失。

result-from.en: Many health problems result from a poor diet and too little exercise.
result-from.zh: 许多健康问题是由不良饮食和缺乏运动导致的。

lead-to.en: Too much screen time may lead to poor sleep among teenagers.
lead-to.zh: 过多使用电子屏幕可能导致青少年睡眠不佳。

give-rise-to.en: The growth of trade gave rise to a new class of wealthy merchants.
give-rise-to.zh: 贸易发展催生了一个新的富商阶层。

contribute-to.en: Several factors contribute to the decline of bee populations.
contribute-to.zh: 有几个因素促成了蜜蜂数量的减少。

stem-from.en: Many of the city's traffic problems stem from its narrow medieval streets.
stem-from.zh: 这座城市的许多交通问题源于狭窄的中世纪街道。

derive-from.en: Many English words derive from Latin or from ancient Greek.
derive-from.zh: 许多英语单词来源于拉丁语或古希腊语。

trigger.en: Even a small earthquake can trigger a large landslide on steep slopes.
trigger.zh: 即使是小地震,也可能在陡坡上引发大规模滑坡。

trigger.en: Stress is a common trigger for headaches among office workers.
trigger.zh: 压力是办公室职员头痛的常见诱因。

induce.en: The drug was used to induce sleep in patients before an operation.
induce.zh: 这种药曾用于在手术前诱导患者入睡。

generate.en: Wind farms now generate a large share of the country's electricity.
generate.zh: 风电场现在产生该国很大一部分电力。

yield.en: The new variety of rice can yield twice as much as older types.
yield.zh: 这种新水稻品种的产量可达旧品种的两倍。

yield.en: The wheat yield fell sharply during the years of low rainfall.
yield.zh: 在降雨少的年份,小麦产量急剧下降。

account-for.en: Differences in diet may account for the lower rates of heart disease.
account-for.zh: 饮食差异也许能解释心脏病发病率较低的原因。

account-for.en: Older people now account for a quarter of the town's population.
account-for.zh: 老年人现在占该镇人口的四分之一。

due-to.en: The population of the village fell due to a lack of jobs.
due-to.zh: 由于缺少工作机会,这个村庄的人口减少了。

owing-to.en: Owing to the dry climate, very few plants can grow in this region.
owing-to.zh: 由于气候干燥,这一地区几乎没有植物能够生长。

thereby.en: Trees provide shade for buildings, thereby reducing the need for air conditioning.
thereby.zh: 树木为建筑遮阴,从而减少了对空调的需求。

thus.en: The river changed course, and thus the town lost its main trade route.
thus.zh: 河流改道了,这座城镇因此失去了主要的贸易路线。

hence.en: The soil here is very poor; hence the small number of farms.
hence.zh: 这里的土壤非常贫瘠,因此农场很少。

consequently.en: Prices rose sharply, and consequently many families could not afford bread.
consequently.zh: 价格急剧上涨,因此许多家庭买不起面包。

therefore.en: The sample was small, and therefore the results should be treated carefully.
therefore.zh: 样本量较小,所以应谨慎看待这些结果。

whereas.en: Some birds fly south in winter, whereas others remain in the same area.
whereas.zh: 有些鸟冬天飞往南方,而另一些则留在原地。

while.en: While the first study found a clear link, the second did not.
while.zh: 第一项研究发现了明显的关联,然而第二项没有。

although.en: Although the plant looks dead in summer, its roots remain alive underground.
although.zh: 尽管这种植物夏天看起来已经枯死,但它的根在地下依然活着。

despite.en: Despite years of research, the origin of the language remains unknown.
despite.zh: 尽管经过多年研究,这种语言的起源仍然不明。

nevertheless.en: The evidence is limited; nevertheless, it points in a clear direction.
nevertheless.zh: 证据有限,然而它指向了一个明确的方向。

nonetheless.en: The journey was dangerous, but many people chose to make it nonetheless.
nonetheless.zh: 这段旅程很危险,尽管如此,许多人还是选择了出发。

notwithstanding.en: Notwithstanding these difficulties, the project was completed ahead of schedule.
notwithstanding.zh: 尽管有这些困难,项目还是提前完成了。

moreover.en: The new bridge is cheaper to build; moreover, it requires little maintenance.
moreover.zh: 新桥造价更低,此外,它几乎不需要维护。

furthermore.en: The drug is effective; furthermore, it has very few side effects.
furthermore.zh: 这种药很有效,此外,它的副作用也很少。

in-addition.en: In addition to food, the forest provides local people with medicine.
in-addition.zh: 除了食物,森林还为当地人提供药物。

likewise.en: Children copy the speech of their parents, and they likewise copy their behaviour.
likewise.zh: 孩子模仿父母说话,同样也模仿他们的行为。

similarly.en: Bats use sound to find food; similarly, dolphins hunt using echoes.
similarly.zh: 蝙蝠利用声音寻找食物,类似地,海豚也靠回声捕猎。

conversely.en: Warm air rises; conversely, cold air tends to sink towards the ground.
conversely.zh: 热空气上升,相反地,冷空气往往下沉到地面。

in-contrast.en: In contrast, the northern part of the country receives very little rain.
in-contrast.zh: 相比之下,该国北部的降雨量很少。

on-the-contrary.en: The noise did not harm the birds; on the contrary, they seemed unaffected.
on-the-contrary.zh: 噪音并没有伤害这些鸟,恰恰相反,它们似乎完全不受影响。

alternatively.en: Waste can be burned for energy or, alternatively, turned into fertiliser.
alternatively.zh: 废弃物可以焚烧发电,或者制成肥料。

namely.en: The study focused on two groups, namely farmers and factory workers.
namely.zh: 这项研究聚焦于两个群体,即农民和工厂工人。

in-terms-of.en: In terms of cost, solar power is now cheaper than coal in many countries.
in-terms-of.zh: 就成本而言,在许多国家太阳能现在比煤炭便宜。

with-regard-to.en: Little is known with regard to the diet of these early humans.
with-regard-to.zh: 关于这些早期人类的饮食,人们所知甚少。

in-respect-of.en: The two languages differ in respect of their grammar and their sound systems.
in-respect-of.zh: 这两种语言在语法和语音系统方面有所不同。

provided-that.en: The species can survive, provided that its habitat is protected.
provided-that.zh: 只要栖息地得到保护,这个物种就能存活下来。

unless.en: Many of these languages will disappear unless action is taken soon.
unless.zh: 除非尽快采取行动,否则这些语言中的许多将会消失。

whereby.en: Photosynthesis is the process whereby plants turn sunlight into food.
whereby.zh: 光合作用是植物把阳光转化为养分的过程。

subsequently.en: The disease first appeared in Asia and subsequently spread to Europe.
subsequently.zh: 这种疾病最早出现在亚洲,随后传到了欧洲。

previously.en: The fossils belong to a species that was previously unknown to science.
previously.zh: 这些化石属于一个此前科学界未知的物种。

simultaneously.en: Bees can carry pollen and collect nectar simultaneously as they move between flowers.
simultaneously.zh: 蜜蜂在花间穿行时,能够同时携带花粉并采集花蜜。

ultimately.en: The choice of treatment is ultimately a matter for the patient to decide.
ultimately.zh: 治疗方案最终要由患者决定。

initially.en: The project was initially planned to last just two years.
initially.zh: 这个项目最初计划只持续两年。

eventually.en: The small settlement eventually grew into one of the region's largest cities.
eventually.zh: 这个小定居点最终发展成该地区最大的城市之一。

prior-to.en: Few people in the area could read prior to the opening of the school.
prior-to.zh: 学校开办之前,当地很少有人识字。

correspondingly.en: As incomes rise, spending on leisure tends to increase correspondingly.
correspondingly.zh: 随着收入增加,休闲支出往往也相应增长。

accordingly.en: Conditions change quickly, and farmers must adjust their methods accordingly.
accordingly.zh: 环境变化很快,农民必须相应地调整耕作方法。

inevitably.en: Rapid growth inevitably puts pressure on housing and public transport.
inevitably.zh: 快速增长不可避免地给住房和公共交通带来压力。

arguably.en: The printing press was arguably the most important invention of that period.
arguably.zh: 可以说,印刷机是那个时期最重要的发明。

amongst.en: The custom is still common amongst people in the northern islands.
amongst.zh: 这一习俗在北部岛屿的人们之中仍很常见。

precede.en: Changes in animal behaviour may precede a major earthquake by several days.
precede.zh: 动物行为的变化可能先于大地震几天出现。

afterwards.en: The volcano erupted in 1815, and the climate cooled for several years afterwards.
afterwards.zh: 这座火山于 1815 年喷发,此后几年气候变冷。

contrary.en: Contrary to popular belief, camels do not store water in their humps.
contrary.zh: 与普遍看法相反,骆驼的驼峰并不储水。

contrary.en: There is no evidence to the contrary, so the theory is still accepted.
contrary.zh: 没有相反的证据,所以这一理论仍被接受。

sometime.en: The city was abandoned sometime in the twelfth century, but nobody knows why.
sometime.zh: 这座城市在十二世纪的某个时候被遗弃,但没人知道原因。

whoever.en: Whoever built this wall had a good knowledge of engineering.
whoever.zh: 无论这堵墙是谁建的,此人都很懂工程学。

whichever.en: Animals usually take whichever route uses the least energy.
whichever.zh: 动物通常会选择耗能最少的路线,无论是哪一条。

crucial.en: Bees play a crucial role in the production of many food crops.
crucial.zh: 蜜蜂在许多粮食作物的生产中起着关键作用。

vital.en: Clean water is vital for the health of any community.
vital.zh: 清洁的水对任何社区的健康都至关重要。

essential.en: Iron is essential for the production of healthy red blood cells.
essential.zh: 铁对于生成健康的红细胞是必要的。

fundamental.en: There is a fundamental difference between human language and animal signals.
fundamental.zh: 人类语言和动物信号之间有根本的区别。

indispensable.en: Mobile phones have become an indispensable part of modern life.
indispensable.zh: 手机已成为现代生活中不可或缺的一部分。

paramount.en: Safety is of paramount importance in the design of nuclear power stations.
paramount.zh: 在核电站设计中,安全是最重要的。

predominant.en: Rice is the predominant crop in the wet southern part of the country.
predominant.zh: 水稻是该国潮湿南部的主要作物。

prevalent.en: This disease is more prevalent in hot and humid parts of the world.
prevalent.zh: 这种疾病在世界上炎热潮湿的地区更普遍。

widespread.en: The use of the plough became widespread across Europe in the Middle Ages.
widespread.zh: 中世纪时,犁在欧洲各地得到了广泛使用。

common.en: Short-sightedness has become increasingly common among children in cities.
common.zh: 近视在城市儿童中变得越来越常见。

rare.en: The rare plant grows only on a few mountains in the south.
rare.zh: 这种罕见的植物只生长在南部的几座山上。

unique.en: The island is home to a unique species of lizard found nowhere else.
unique.zh: 这座岛上有一种独特的蜥蜴,在其他地方都找不到。

distinct.en: The study identified three distinct stages in the development of speech.
distinct.zh: 这项研究确定了语言发展的三个不同阶段。

distinctive.en: The bird is easily recognised by its distinctive red tail feathers.
distinctive.zh: 这种鸟很容易凭借独特的红色尾羽辨认出来。

inherent.en: There are risks inherent in any form of deep-sea exploration.
inherent.zh: 任何形式的深海探索都有固有的风险。

intrinsic.en: Students learn better when they find an intrinsic interest in the subject.
intrinsic.zh: 学生对学科有内在兴趣时学得更好。

potential.en: The potential benefits of the new treatment are still being studied.
potential.zh: 这种新疗法的潜在益处仍在研究之中。

potential.en: Tidal energy has great potential as a clean source of electricity.
potential.zh: 潮汐能作为清洁电力来源具有巨大潜力。

feasible.en: It is not yet feasible to store large amounts of electricity cheaply.
feasible.zh: 廉价储存大量电力目前还不可行。

viable.en: Electric buses are now a viable alternative to those powered by diesel.
viable.zh: 电动公交车现在是柴油公交车的可行替代品。

practical.en: The method works well in theory but has few practical uses.
practical.zh: 这种方法理论上很好,但实际用途很少。

pragmatic.en: Local leaders took a pragmatic approach and worked with both sides.
pragmatic.zh: 当地领导人采取了务实的做法,与双方都展开合作。

efficient.en: Modern engines are far more efficient than those of fifty years ago.
efficient.zh: 现代发动机比五十年前的高效得多。

effective.en: Vaccination remains the most effective way of preventing the disease.
effective.zh: 接种疫苗仍是预防这种疾病最有效的方法。

beneficial.en: A moderate amount of exercise is beneficial for people of all ages.
beneficial.zh: 适量运动对各个年龄段的人都有益。

detrimental.en: Too much noise can be detrimental to children's ability to concentrate.
detrimental.zh: 过多噪音可能损害儿童的注意力。

harmful.en: Many cleaning products contain chemicals that are harmful to river life.
harmful.zh: 许多清洁产品含有对河流生物有害的化学物质。

adverse.en: Most patients taking the drug reported no adverse effects.
adverse.zh: 大多数服用这种药的患者报告没有不良反应。

negative.en: The new road had a negative effect on the local bird population.
negative.zh: 新公路对当地鸟类数量产生了负面影响。

positive.en: Regular contact with nature has a positive effect on mental health.
positive.zh: 经常接触大自然对心理健康有积极影响。

profound.en: The invention of writing had a profound effect on human society.
profound.zh: 文字的发明对人类社会产生了深远影响。

far-reaching.en: The discovery of antibiotics had far-reaching consequences for modern medicine.
far-reaching.zh: 抗生素的发现对现代医学产生了深远的影响。

long-term.en: Little is known about the long-term effects of this chemical on humans.
long-term.zh: 人们对这种化学物质对人体的长期影响知之甚少。

short-term.en: The drug provides short-term relief but does not cure the illness.
short-term.zh: 这种药能短期缓解症状,但无法治愈疾病。

temporary.en: Workers lived in temporary housing while the new town was being built.
temporary.zh: 新城建设期间,工人们住在临时住房里。

permanent.en: Exposure to very loud noise can cause permanent damage to hearing.
permanent.zh: 暴露在极大的噪音中可能造成永久性听力损伤。

sustainable.en: Farmers are being encouraged to adopt more sustainable methods of fishing.
sustainable.zh: 人们鼓励渔民采用更可持续的捕鱼方法。

appropriate.en: Teachers must choose materials that are appropriate for the age of the children.
appropriate.zh: 教师必须选择适合孩子年龄的教材。

adequate.en: Many people in the region still do not have adequate access to clean water.
adequate.zh: 该地区的许多人仍然无法获得足够的清洁水。

sufficient.en: There is not yet sufficient evidence to support this explanation.
sufficient.zh: 目前还没有充足的证据支持这一解释。

insufficient.en: Insufficient funding forced the museum to close two of its galleries.
insufficient.zh: 资金不足迫使博物馆关闭了两个展厅。

excessive.en: Excessive use of fertiliser can pollute nearby rivers and lakes.
excessive.zh: 过度使用化肥会污染附近的河流和湖泊。

minimal.en: The new design causes minimal disturbance to the surrounding environment.
minimal.zh: 新设计对周围环境的干扰极小。

maximum.en: Plants reach their maximum height after about three months of growth.
maximum.zh: 植物生长约三个月后达到最大高度。

optimal.en: The optimal temperature for growing this crop is about twenty-five degrees.
optimal.zh: 种植这种作物的最佳温度约为二十五度。

ideal.en: The warm, shallow water provides ideal conditions for young fish.
ideal.zh: 温暖的浅水为幼鱼提供了理想的环境。

complex.en: The human brain is the most complex organ in the body.
complex.zh: 人脑是身体中最复杂的器官。

sophisticated.en: The ancient Egyptians developed a sophisticated system for moving water to their fields.
sophisticated.zh: 古埃及人发展出一套精密的系统,把水引到田地里。

straightforward.en: The answer to this question is not as straightforward as it seems.
straightforward.zh: 这个问题的答案并不像看起来那么简单。

explicit.en: The report makes no explicit reference to the cost of the project.
explicit.zh: 报告没有明确提及项目的成本。

implicit.en: There is an implicit assumption in the theory that people always act rationally.
implicit.zh: 这个理论隐含着一个假定:人总是理性行事。

ambiguous.en: The results of the test were ambiguous and open to different interpretations.
ambiguous.zh: 测试结果模棱两可,可以有不同的解释。

obvious.en: The benefits of the new system were not immediately obvious to farmers.
obvious.zh: 新系统的好处对农民来说并非立刻就能看出来。

apparent.en: It soon became apparent that the water was no longer safe to drink.
apparent.zh: 很快人们就发现,这些水已经不能安全饮用了。

apparent.en: The apparent increase in cases may simply reflect better testing.
apparent.zh: 病例表面上的增加可能只是反映了检测手段的改善。

evident.en: The effects of the drought were evident in the dry fields.
evident.zh: 干旱的影响在干涸的田地里十分明显。

notable.en: One notable feature of this building is its unusual roof.
notable.zh: 这座建筑值得注意的一个特点是不同寻常的屋顶。

remarkable.en: Some birds have a remarkable ability to find their way home.
remarkable.zh: 有些鸟具有非凡的认路回家的能力。

striking.en: There is a striking similarity between the two languages.
striking.zh: 这两种语言有显著的相似之处。

considerably.en: The cost of solar panels has fallen considerably over the past decade.
considerably.zh: 过去十年,太阳能电池板的成本大幅下降。

relatively.en: The disease is relatively rare among people under the age of forty.
relatively.zh: 这种疾病在四十岁以下人群中相对少见。

comparatively.en: The town remained comparatively small until the arrival of the railway.
comparatively.zh: 铁路通车之前,这座城镇一直比较小。

largely.en: The success of the project was largely due to local support.
largely.zh: 这个项目的成功在很大程度上归功于当地人的支持。

primarily.en: This species feeds primarily on insects found under the bark of trees.
primarily.zh: 这种动物主要以树皮下的昆虫为食。

predominantly.en: The workforce in the factory was predominantly female until the 1950s.
predominantly.zh: 直到 20 世纪 50 年代,这家工厂的工人主要是女性。

partially.en: The ancient wall has been partially destroyed by centuries of wind and rain.
partially.zh: 几个世纪的风雨已使这堵古墙部分毁坏。

entirely.en: The building is powered entirely by energy from the sun.
entirely.zh: 这座建筑完全由太阳能供电。

virtually.en: Virtually all the land in the valley is now used for farming.
virtually.zh: 山谷里几乎所有的土地现在都用于耕作。

merely.en: These figures are merely estimates and may not reflect the real situation.
merely.zh: 这些数字仅仅是估算,可能不反映真实情况。

solely.en: The decision should not be based solely on the cost of the project.
solely.zh: 这项决定不应只基于项目成本。

specifically.en: The programme was designed specifically for children with reading difficulties.
specifically.zh: 这个项目是专门为有阅读困难的儿童设计的。

particularly.en: The city's air quality is particularly poor during the winter months.
particularly.zh: 这座城市的空气质量在冬季特别差。

notably.en: Some countries, notably Denmark, now produce most of their power from wind.
notably.zh: 一些国家,尤其是丹麦,现在大部分电力来自风能。

increasingly.en: Young people are increasingly choosing to live in smaller homes.
increasingly.zh: 年轻人越来越多地选择住小户型。

unprecedented.en: The city experienced unprecedented growth during the last century.
unprecedented.zh: 上个世纪,这座城市经历了前所未有的增长。

overwhelming.en: There is overwhelming evidence that smoking damages the lungs.
overwhelming.zh: 有压倒性的证据表明吸烟会损害肺部。

prevailing.en: The prevailing view at the time was that bad air caused the illness.
prevailing.zh: 当时盛行的观点是这种疾病由污浊的空气引起。

extensive.en: The fire caused extensive damage to the forests in the north.
extensive.zh: 这场大火对北部森林造成了大面积破坏。

invaluable.en: These old diaries are an invaluable source of information for historians.
invaluable.zh: 这些旧日记对历史学家来说是极其宝贵的信息来源。

versatile.en: Bamboo is a versatile material used for building, cooking and making paper.
versatile.zh: 竹子是一种多用途材料,可用于建筑、烹饪和造纸。

specialised.en: The work requires specialised equipment that few laboratories can afford.
specialised.zh: 这项工作需要专门的设备,很少有实验室买得起。

diverse.en: The region has a diverse population speaking more than twenty languages.
diverse.zh: 该地区人口多样,使用二十多种语言。

exclusive.en: The club was once exclusive to men from wealthy families.
exclusive.zh: 这家俱乐部曾经只面向富裕家庭的男性。

dominant.en: English has become the dominant language of international science.
dominant.zh: 英语已成为国际科学界的主导语言。

severe.en: The region suffered a severe drought that lasted for almost three years.
severe.zh: 该地区遭受了持续近三年的严重干旱。

rigid.en: The school's rigid rules left little room for creative teaching.
rigid.zh: 学校僵化的规定几乎没有留下创造性教学的空间。

stringent.en: The law introduced stringent controls on the use of pesticides.
stringent.zh: 这项法律对农药使用实施了严格的管控。

impartial.en: The committee must remain impartial when judging the competing proposals.
impartial.zh: 评审相互竞争的提案时,委员会必须保持公正。

misleading.en: Averages can be misleading when a few very high values are included.
misleading.zh: 包含少数极高数值时,平均数可能具有误导性。

inconceivable.en: A century ago, instant global communication would have seemed inconceivable to most people.
inconceivable.zh: 一个世纪前,大多数人会觉得全球即时通信难以想象。

threat.en: Rising sea levels pose a serious threat to low-lying islands.
threat.zh: 海平面上升对低洼岛屿构成严重威胁。

hazard.en: Falling rocks are a constant hazard for people working in the mine.
hazard.zh: 落石对矿工来说始终是一种危险。

jeopardy.en: Thousands of jobs were put in jeopardy when the factory lost its main customer.
jeopardy.zh: 工厂失去主要客户后,数千个工作岗位陷入危险境地。

deliberately.en: Some early farmers deliberately burned forests to clear land for crops.
deliberately.zh: 一些早期农民故意焚烧森林,开垦土地种庄稼。

readily.en: The metal reacts readily with water, so it must be stored in oil.
readily.zh: 这种金属容易与水发生反应,所以必须存放在油中。

prominent.en: Women played a prominent role in the early history of the movement.
prominent.zh: 女性在这场运动的早期历史中发挥了突出的作用。

purely.en: The decision to close the school was made for purely financial reasons.
purely.zh: 关闭学校的决定完全是出于财务原因。

outer.en: The outer layer of the skin protects the body from infection.
outer.zh: 皮肤的外层保护身体免受感染。

bound.en: With so many cars on the road, traffic problems are bound to get worse.
bound.zh: 路上汽车这么多,交通问题必定会恶化。

naked.en: Many of these stars cannot be seen with the naked eye.
naked.zh: 这些恒星中有许多用肉眼是看不见的。

formally.en: The treaty was formally signed by both countries in 1848.
formally.zh: 两国于 1848 年正式签署了这项条约。

superior.en: The new material proved superior to steel in almost every test.
superior.zh: 事实证明,这种新材料在几乎所有测试中都优于钢材。

superior.en: Employees often feel unable to disagree openly with their superiors.
superior.zh: 员工常常觉得无法公开反对上级。

subtle.en: Even subtle changes in temperature can affect how these insects behave.
subtle.zh: 即使温度的细微变化,也会影响这些昆虫的行为。

realistic.en: It is not realistic to expect all cars to be electric within ten years.
realistic.zh: 指望十年内所有汽车都变成电动的,并不现实。

correctly.en: Only a third of participants answered all the questions correctly.
correctly.zh: 只有三分之一的参与者答对了所有问题。

locally.en: The restaurant uses only vegetables that are grown locally.
locally.zh: 这家餐厅只用当地种植的蔬菜。

progressive.en: The city was known for its progressive attitude towards women's education.
progressive.zh: 这座城市以对女性教育的进步态度而闻名。

progressive.en: The illness causes a progressive loss of memory over many years.
progressive.zh: 这种疾病会在多年间造成记忆力的渐进性衰退。

indirect.en: Pollution has an indirect effect on birds by reducing their supply of food.
indirect.zh: 污染通过减少食物来源,对鸟类产生间接影响。

vague.en: Early descriptions of the disease were too vague to be useful.
vague.zh: 早期对这种疾病的描述过于模糊,没有什么用处。

incredibly.en: Spider silk is incredibly strong for such a light material.
incredibly.zh: 作为如此轻的材料,蛛丝极其坚韧。

actively.en: Students learn more when they take part actively in discussions.
actively.zh: 学生积极参与讨论时学到的更多。

irrelevant.en: Much of the information in the report is irrelevant to the main question.
irrelevant.zh: 报告中的许多信息与主要问题无关。

supposedly.en: The treatment is supposedly safe, but few long-term studies have been done.
supposedly.zh: 据说这种疗法是安全的,但很少有长期研究。

terribly.en: The early flying machines were terribly difficult to control.
terribly.zh: 早期的飞行器非常难操控。

selective.en: Bees are selective about which flowers they visit for food.
selective.zh: 蜜蜂对采食的花朵很挑剔。

backward.en: In the nineteenth century, the region was seen as economically backward.
backward.zh: 在十九世纪,这一地区被视为经济落后。

problematic.en: Comparing data from different countries can be problematic for researchers.
problematic.zh: 比较不同国家的数据对研究者来说可能有问题。

obscure.en: The word comes from an obscure dialect spoken in the far north.
obscure.zh: 这个词来自远北地区一种鲜为人知的方言。

obscure.en: Thick clouds often obscure the top of the mountain from view.
obscure.zh: 厚厚的云层常常遮住山顶。

nicely.en: The findings fit nicely with what we already know about memory.
nicely.zh: 这些发现与我们已知的记忆知识很好地吻合。

spontaneous.en: Children's spontaneous play helps them to develop social skills.
spontaneous.zh: 儿童自发的游戏有助于发展社交能力。

trivial.en: Decisions that seem trivial can have large effects over a long period.
trivial.zh: 看似琐碎的决定,长期来看可能产生很大影响。

peripheral.en: The issue was once considered peripheral to the main concerns of economists.
peripheral.zh: 这个问题曾被认为对经济学家的主要关注点而言只是次要的。

tricky.en: Measuring happiness is a tricky task for any social scientist.
tricky.zh: 对任何社会科学家来说,衡量幸福都是一项棘手的任务。

unstable.en: The cliffs along this coast are unstable and could fall at any time.
unstable.zh: 这段海岸的悬崖不稳定,随时可能坍塌。

lateral.en: The tree has strong lateral roots that spread close to the surface.
lateral.zh: 这种树有粗壮的侧根,贴近地表生长。

coherent.en: The author fails to present a coherent explanation of the data.
coherent.zh: 作者未能对数据作出条理清楚的解释。

suitable.en: Much of the land in the north is not suitable for growing crops.
suitable.zh: 北部的许多土地不适合种植庄稼。

supreme.en: The emperor held supreme power over all parts of the empire.
supreme.zh: 皇帝对帝国各地拥有最高权力。

unlikely.en: It is unlikely that this species will survive without human help.
unlikely.zh: 没有人类的帮助,这个物种不太可能存活。

elsewhere.en: The plant grows on this island but has not been found elsewhere in Europe.
elsewhere.zh: 这种植物生长在这座岛上,在欧洲其他地方都没有发现。

somewhat.en: The results of later surveys were somewhat different from those of the first.
somewhat.zh: 后来几次调查的结果与第一次略有不同。

typical.en: A typical nest contains between three and five eggs.
typical.zh: 一个典型的巢里有三到五枚蛋。

external.en: External factors, such as the weather, can affect the results of the test.
external.zh: 天气等外部因素可能影响测试结果。

contemporary.en: Contemporary artists are exploring new ways of using digital technology.
contemporary.zh: 当代艺术家正在探索运用数字技术的新方式。

contemporary.en: Shakespeare and his contemporaries wrote many plays for the London stage.
contemporary.zh: 莎士比亚和与他同时代的人为伦敦舞台写了许多戏剧。

barely.en: The village is barely visible from the road because of the trees.
barely.zh: 由于树木遮挡,从公路上几乎看不见这个村庄。

unusual.en: It is unusual for this type of bird to build a nest on the ground.
unusual.zh: 这种鸟在地面筑巢是不寻常的。

voluntary.en: Participation in the study was voluntary, and people could leave at any time.
voluntary.zh: 参与这项研究是自愿的,人们可以随时退出。

intense.en: The intense heat of the fire melted the metal parts of the building.
intense.zh: 大火的高温熔化了建筑的金属部件。

visible.en: The effects of pollution are clearly visible on the old stone walls.
visible.zh: 污染的影响在古老的石墙上清晰可见。

radical.en: The new technology brought about a radical change in the way people work.
radical.zh: 新技术使人们的工作方式发生了根本的变化。

pure.en: The cave contains pure water that has been filtered through the rock.
pure.zh: 洞穴里有经过岩石过滤的纯净水。

literally.en: The name of the town literally means 'place by the river'.
literally.zh: 这个城镇的名字字面意思是“河边的地方”。

extreme.en: Few plants can survive the extreme cold of the Arctic winter.
extreme.zh: 很少有植物能在北极冬天的极端严寒中存活。

presumably.en: The tools were found by the river, presumably because people fished there.
presumably.zh: 这些工具是在河边发现的,大概是因为人们在那里捕鱼。

genuine.en: Experts confirmed that the painting was a genuine work by the artist.
genuine.zh: 专家确认这幅画是这位画家的真迹。

distant.en: The light from distant stars can take millions of years to reach us.
distant.zh: 来自遥远恒星的光可能要数百万年才能到达我们这里。

raw.en: The factory imports raw materials and turns them into finished goods.
raw.zh: 这家工厂进口原材料,把它们加工成成品。

ongoing.en: Ongoing research suggests that the drug may also help with memory loss.
ongoing.zh: 正在进行的研究表明,这种药也可能有助于改善记忆减退。

undoubtedly.en: The railway undoubtedly helped the town's economy to grow.
undoubtedly.zh: 铁路无疑促进了这座城镇的经济增长。

flexible.en: Young children's brains are more flexible than those of adults.
flexible.zh: 幼儿的大脑比成年人的更灵活。

inadequate.en: Inadequate lighting in the classroom may affect students' eyesight.
inadequate.zh: 教室照明不足可能影响学生的视力。

underlying.en: Doctors must treat the underlying cause rather than just the symptoms.
underlying.zh: 医生必须治疗根本病因,而不只是症状。

sheer.en: The sheer size of the building impressed visitors from all over the world.
sheer.zh: 这座建筑的庞大规模本身就令世界各地的游客赞叹。

sheer.en: The birds nest on sheer cliffs high above the sea.
sheer.zh: 这些鸟把巢筑在高高的海上峭壁上。

harsh.en: Few animals can survive the harsh conditions of the desert in summer.
harsh.zh: 很少有动物能在夏季沙漠的严酷环境中生存。

reluctant.en: Many farmers were reluctant to change the methods they had always used.
reluctant.zh: 许多农民不愿改变一直使用的方法。

seemingly.en: A seemingly simple task can involve many different parts of the brain.
seemingly.zh: 一项表面上简单的任务可能涉及大脑的许多不同区域。

random.en: Participants were chosen at random from a list of local residents.
random.zh: 参与者是从当地居民名单中随机选出的。

invisible.en: Air pollution is often invisible, but it can seriously damage health.
invisible.zh: 空气污染往往看不见,但会严重损害健康。

fierce.en: There is fierce competition for land between farmers and developers.
fierce.zh: 农民和开发商之间对土地的争夺十分激烈。

bold.en: The architect's bold design was criticised by many people at the time.
bold.zh: 这位建筑师大胆的设计在当时受到许多人的批评。

stiff.en: Sitting for long hours can leave the muscles of the back stiff.
stiff.zh: 久坐会使背部肌肉僵硬。

awkward.en: Moving such a heavy statue was an awkward and dangerous task.
awkward.zh: 搬运这么重的雕像既笨拙又危险。

invariably.en: In these conditions, the experiment invariably produced the same result.
invariably.zh: 在这些条件下,实验总是产生相同的结果。

forthcoming.en: Further details of the study will appear in a forthcoming article.
forthcoming.zh: 这项研究的更多细节将在一篇即将发表的文章中公布。

hitherto.en: The cave contained hitherto unknown species of insects and spiders.
hitherto.zh: 洞穴里有迄今未知的昆虫和蜘蛛物种。

intimate.en: Language has an intimate connection with a people's sense of identity.
intimate.zh: 语言与一个民族的身份认同有着密切的联系。

secular.en: The country's schools became fully secular at the end of the nineteenth century.
secular.zh: 这个国家的学校在十九世纪末完全世俗化了。

worthwhile.en: Learning a second language is a worthwhile activity at any age.
worthwhile.zh: 无论什么年龄,学习第二语言都是值得的。

sympathetic.en: Local people were sympathetic to the workers and gave them food.
sympathetic.zh: 当地人同情这些工人,给他们送去了食物。

anonymous.en: All the answers in the survey were kept anonymous to protect the participants.
anonymous.zh: 调查的所有答案都是匿名的,以保护参与者。

fatal.en: Without treatment, the disease is fatal in about half of all cases.
fatal.zh: 如果不治疗,这种疾病约有一半的病例是致命的。

peculiar.en: The peculiar shape of the rocks was caused by the wind.
peculiar.zh: 这些岩石奇特的形状是风造成的。

immense.en: The dam has brought immense benefits to farmers along the river.
immense.zh: 这座大坝给沿河农民带来了巨大的好处。

eligible.en: Only people over eighteen were eligible to take part in the study.
eligible.zh: 只有十八岁以上的人才有资格参加这项研究。

intact.en: The ship was found almost intact on the bottom of the lake.
intact.zh: 这艘船在湖底被发现时几乎完好无损。

doubtful.en: It is doubtful whether the species could survive in the wild.
doubtful.zh: 这个物种能否在野外存活还不确定。

brutal.en: Workers in early coal mines often faced brutal conditions underground.
brutal.zh: 早期煤矿的工人在地下常常面临残酷的条件。

deliberate.en: Researchers believe the fire was a deliberate attempt to clear the land.
deliberate.zh: 研究者认为这场大火是有意开垦土地的尝试。

deliberate.en: The committee will deliberate for several weeks before making its decision.
deliberate.zh: 委员会将仔细考虑几周,然后作出决定。

utterly.en: The village was utterly destroyed by the eruption of the volcano.
utterly.zh: 这个村庄被火山喷发完全摧毁了。

devastating.en: The storm had a devastating effect on the island's fishing industry.
devastating.zh: 这场风暴对岛上的渔业造成了毁灭性的影响。

consecutive.en: The region has experienced drought for five consecutive years.
consecutive.zh: 该地区已经连续五年遭遇干旱。

orthodox.en: His ideas went against the orthodox view of how the disease spread.
orthodox.zh: 他的想法与这种疾病传播方式的正统观点相悖。

thorough.en: A thorough examination of the site revealed several unusual objects.
thorough.zh: 对现场的彻底检查发现了几件不寻常的物品。

formidable.en: Crossing the desert on foot was a formidable challenge for the early explorers.
formidable.zh: 徒步穿越沙漠对早期探险家来说是一项艰巨的挑战。

grim.en: The report presents a grim picture of the future of the coral reefs.
grim.zh: 报告描绘了珊瑚礁未来的严峻前景。

vigorous.en: Thirty minutes of vigorous exercise a day can greatly reduce the risk of illness.
vigorous.zh: 每天三十分钟的高强度运动可以大大降低患病风险。

eternal.en: Many ancient cultures believed in the eternal life of the soul.
eternal.zh: 许多古代文化相信灵魂永恒不灭。

absurd.en: The idea of flying machines once seemed absurd to most people.
absurd.zh: 飞行器的想法曾让大多数人觉得荒谬。

destructive.en: Floods can be highly destructive in areas where trees have been removed.
destructive.zh: 在树木被砍伐的地区,洪水的破坏性可能很大。

supplementary.en: Supplementary classes were offered to children who had fallen behind.
supplementary.zh: 学校为落后的孩子提供了补充课程。

credible.en: There is no credible evidence that the ancient city ever existed.
credible.zh: 没有可信的证据表明这座古城曾经存在。

wary.en: Wild animals are usually wary of humans and keep their distance.
wary.zh: 野生动物通常对人类很警惕,并保持距离。

notorious.en: This stretch of coast is notorious for its dangerous rocks and strong currents.
notorious.zh: 这段海岸因危险的礁石和湍急的水流而臭名昭著。

doubtless.en: The new museum will doubtless attract a large number of tourists.
doubtless.zh: 新博物馆无疑将吸引大量游客。

solitary.en: Unlike lions, most other big cats lead a solitary life.
solitary.zh: 与狮子不同,大多数其他大型猫科动物独自生活。

outrageous.en: Local people thought the price charged for water was outrageous.
outrageous.zh: 当地人认为水价高得令人愤慨。

provisional.en: These figures are provisional and may be changed when more data arrives.
provisional.zh: 这些数字是临时的,更多数据到来后可能会更改。

foremost.en: She became one of the foremost experts on ancient languages in Europe.
foremost.zh: 她成为欧洲最重要的古代语言专家之一。

petty.en: Most of the crimes in the town were petty thefts of food.
petty.zh: 镇上的大多数犯罪都是偷窃食物这样的小事。

imminent.en: Local people had no warning that the eruption was imminent.
imminent.zh: 当地人事先没有得到火山即将喷发的警告。

robust.en: The study was robust, with a large sample and careful controls.
robust.zh: 这项研究十分稳健,样本量大,对照也很严谨。

prestigious.en: She won a place at one of the country's most prestigious universities.
prestigious.zh: 她考上了全国最有声望的大学之一。

superficial.en: The similarities between the two species are only superficial.
superficial.zh: 这两个物种之间的相似之处只是表面的。

conspicuous.en: Male birds often have conspicuous colours that attract females.
conspicuous.zh: 雄鸟通常有吸引雌鸟的显眼颜色。

abnormal.en: Blood tests showed abnormal levels of iron in some of the workers.
abnormal.zh: 血液检查显示,部分工人体内铁含量异常。

volatile.en: Food prices can be volatile when harvests vary greatly from year to year.
volatile.zh: 当每年收成差异很大时,粮价可能波动剧烈。

volatile.en: Volatile chemicals quickly turn into gas at room temperature.
volatile.zh: 易挥发的化学物质在室温下很快变成气体。

dubious.en: The company's claims about the health benefits of its tea are dubious.
dubious.zh: 该公司关于其茶叶健康益处的说法很可疑。

drastic.en: The drought forced the government to take drastic action to save water.
drastic.zh: 干旱迫使政府采取严厉措施节约用水。

renowned.en: The region is renowned for the quality of its olive oil.
renowned.zh: 这一地区以优质橄榄油著称。

uneven.en: The uneven distribution of rainfall makes farming difficult in some areas.
uneven.zh: 降雨分布不均使一些地区难以耕作。

irregular.en: The stars in this group vary in brightness at irregular intervals.
irregular.zh: 这组恒星的亮度以不规则的间隔变化。

coarse.en: The cloth was made from coarse wool and was worn by farm workers.
coarse.zh: 这种布是用粗羊毛织成的,供农场工人穿着。

relentless.en: The relentless growth of the city has swallowed up nearby villages.
relentless.zh: 城市持续不断的扩张吞并了附近的村庄。

blunt.en: Early stone tools were often blunt and had to be sharpened regularly.
blunt.zh: 早期的石器常常很钝,需要定期打磨。

tangible.en: The programme has brought tangible benefits to people in the poorest areas.
tangible.zh: 这个项目给最贫困地区的人们带来了切实的好处。

intricate.en: The temple walls are covered with intricate carvings of animals and plants.
intricate.zh: 寺庙的墙壁上布满了精细的动植物雕刻。

latent.en: The virus can remain latent in the body for many years.
latent.zh: 这种病毒可以在体内潜伏多年。

tentative.en: The team reached a tentative conclusion, which will need further testing.
tentative.zh: 研究团队得出了一个初步结论,还需要进一步检验。

pointless.en: Many workers felt that the new rules were pointless and a waste of time.
pointless.zh: 许多工人觉得新规定毫无意义,纯属浪费时间。

savage.en: The early settlers wrongly described the local people as savage.
savage.zh: 早期定居者错误地把当地人描述为野蛮的。

gigantic.en: Gigantic waves struck the coast after the undersea earthquake.
gigantic.zh: 海底地震后,巨浪袭击了海岸。

idle.en: Much of the farm equipment lies idle for most of the year.
idle.zh: 大部分农业设备一年中多数时间都闲置着。

ruthless.en: The ruthless pursuit of profit caused great harm to the environment.
ruthless.zh: 对利润的无情追逐对环境造成了巨大危害。

subordinate.en: In the old system, the needs of workers were subordinate to those of owners.
subordinate.zh: 在旧制度下,工人的需求次于所有者的需求。

subordinate.en: A good manager listens carefully to the ideas of each subordinate.
subordinate.zh: 好的管理者会认真听取每位下属的想法。

interim.en: An interim report will be published before the end of the project.
interim.zh: 项目结束前将发布一份中期报告。

neighbouring.en: People from neighbouring villages came to trade at the weekly market.
neighbouring.zh: 邻近村庄的人来每周一次的集市上做买卖。

mighty.en: The mighty river once carried goods far into the centre of the continent.
mighty.zh: 这条大河曾把货物运到大陆腹地。

unfair.en: Many people felt that the new tax was unfair to the poor.
unfair.zh: 许多人觉得新税对穷人不公平。
